development_protocol.source_rule: Photos 6–8 of old-package identities only. No 280-new-package identities or query photos used for development.

first_selection.selection_basis: CLAHE/Retinex: highest mean genuine cosine on the development split among candidates with no loss of known-correct count or increase in unknown false accepts; Gamma retains the previously verified production policy. Same .435 decision threshold.

four_view_selection.basis: Same development-only mean-genuine score criterion; six added four-view candidates. Package first-attempt outcome informed further research; package is now repeated evaluation, not fresh held-out evidence.

final_retinex_selection.basis: Highest mean genuine score among 4 global fusion candidates with no development known-correct/FAR regression. Local/mirror Retinex variants failed to improve repeated package evaluation, so avoid their extra feature passes.

search_audit.note: Parameters selected using development images; package outcomes informed subsequent candidate families. Reported package accuracy is repeated evaluation, not untouched generalization evidence.

real_model_smoke.purpose: Real inference / API integration smoke test only
real_model_smoke.performance_claim: NOT a real-scene benchmark. Same-source synthetic variants are correlated; no 95%/90% target is validated.

limitations: Each enhancement evaluated on its corresponding lighting scene; no universal per-image superiority.
120-person regression identities overlap development; query photos differ.
A baseline at 100% cannot be strictly improved.
Small observed gains do not establish statistically significant or universal superiority.
Unknown validation contains 30 identities under 3 simulated lighting conditions, not 90 independent subjects.
CLAHE includes feature mirroring; gains are not attributable to pixel enhancement alone.
Parallel inference time is not application single-image latency.
